WITH date_dim_mv AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
),
store_facts AS (
    SELECT store_sk,
           SUM(sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(profit) AS profit,
           SUM(return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
               ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
               ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
               ss_net_profit AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS return_amt,
               CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS net_loss
        FROM store_sales
        UNION ALL
        SELECT sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
               sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
               CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS sales_price,
               CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS profit,
               sr_return_amt AS return_amt,
               sr_net_loss AS net_loss
        FROM store_returns
    ) store_events
    JOIN date_dim_mv dm ON store_events.date_sk = dm.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY store_sk
),
store_totals AS (
    SELECT st.s_store_id AS s_store_id,
           SUM(sf.sales) AS sales,
           SUM(sf.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(sf.returns) AS returns,
           SUM(sf.profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM store_facts sf
    JOIN store st ON sf.store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY st.s_store_id
),
catalog_facts AS (
    SELECT page_sk,
           SUM(sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(profit) AS profit,
           SUM(return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
               cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
               cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
               cs_net_profit AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS return_amt,
               CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS net_loss
        FROM catalog_sales
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
               cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
               CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS sales_price,
               CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS profit,
               cr_return_amount AS return_amt,
               cr_net_loss AS net_loss
        FROM catalog_returns
    ) catalog_events
    JOIN date_dim_mv dm ON catalog_events.date_sk = dm.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY page_sk
),
catalog_totals AS (
    SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(cf.sales) AS sales,
           SUM(cf.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(cf.returns) AS returns,
           SUM(cf.profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM catalog_facts cf
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cf.page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
web_facts AS (
    SELECT wsr_web_site_sk,
           SUM(sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(profit) AS profit,
           SUM(return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
               ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
               ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
               ws_net_profit AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS return_amt,
               CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS net_loss
        FROM web_sales
        UNION ALL
        SELECT wsa.ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
               wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
               CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS sales_price,
               CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS profit,
               wr.wr_return_amt AS return_amt,
               wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss
        FROM web_returns wr
        LEFT OUTER JOIN web_sales wsa
            ON wr.wr_item_sk = wsa.ws_item_sk
           AND wr.wr_order_number = wsa.ws_order_number
    ) web_events
    JOIN date_dim_mv dm ON web_events.date_sk = dm.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY wsr_web_site_sk
),
web_totals AS (
    SELECT wst.web_site_id AS web_site_id,
           SUM(wf.sales) AS sales,
           SUM(wf.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(wf.returns) AS returns,
           SUM(wf.profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_facts wf
    JOIN web_site wst ON wf.wsr_web_site_sk = wst.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY wst.web_site_id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           'store' || st.s_store_id AS id,
           st.sales AS sales,
           st.returns AS returns,
           (st.profit - st.profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM store_totals st
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           'catalog_page' || ct.cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
           ct.sales AS sales,
           ct.returns AS returns,
           (ct.profit - ct.profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM catalog_totals ct
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           'web_site' || wt.web_site_id AS id,
           wt.sales AS sales,
           wt.returns AS returns,
           (wt.profit - wt.profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM web_totals wt
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
